titulo.es: EE.UU. e Israel señalan a Irán por incidente en vuelo de Flydubai, aunque sin pruebas
titulo.en: Passengers foil bid to crash Dubai-Tel Aviv flight after co-pilot stabbed pilot, Israel says

sintesis.es: Estados Unidos e Israel sugirieron una posible implicación de Irán en el incidente del vuelo de Flydubai que, el 30 de septiembre, se vio obligado a aterrizar de emergencia en Arabia Saudita mientras se dirigía a Tel Aviv. Aunque Israel no ha presentado pruebas que confirmen la participación iraní en un presunto complot para estrellar el avión, el presidente estadounidense anticipó represalias y declaró que "basándome en lo que escucho, Teherán pudo haber estado detrás del fallido atentado".
sintesis.en: Passengers on a FlyDubai flight reached Israel safely on Wednesday after passengers and crew foiled a co-pilot's attempt to crash the aircraft, Israeli officials said, in a struggle that began when he stabbed the pilot and sent the jet plunging.

titulo.es: Francia: publican pantallazos de mensajes antisemitas atribuidos a Jordan Bardella
titulo.en: French website publishes evidence for antisemitism claims against Bardella

sintesis.es: El medio de investigación francés Mediapart, que acusa de comentarios antisemitas al presidente del principal partido de extrema derecha, publicó el jueves capturas de pantalla de mensajes, autenticados por un notario, que él habría enviado a otra persona en 2013. Jordan Bardella presentó contra la publicación denuncias por difamación y falsificación.
sintesis.en: French investigative journalism website Mediapart said Thursday it had been able to authenticate antisemitic messages from 2013 attributed to far-right presidential candidate Marine Le Pen's de facto deputy Jordan Bardella. The allegations come just seven months out from the election where voters will choose a replacement for President Emmanuel Macron, with Le Pen leading opinion polls.

titulo.es: ‘An amazing ride’: SpaceX flight led by first Black female commander sets US speed record
titulo.en: ‘An amazing ride’: SpaceX flight led by first Black female commander sets US speed record

sintesis.es: Four astronauts pulled up at International Space Station after eight-hour express flight led by Jessica Watkins Four astronauts pulled up at the International Space Station (ISS) on Thursday after launching on an eight-hour express that set a US speed record, and that created further history with the first Black woman to lead a crew to orbit. SpaceX launched commander Jessica Watkins and her crew for Nasa after a three-week delay to fix their Dragon capsule’s leaking fuel system. Thick clouds threatened all morning to halt the countdown but skies cleared enough to allow a safe liftoff from Cape Canaveral at 11.10am (1510 GMT).

titulo.es: Brasil: Lula y Bolsonaro eclipsan a los demás candidatos cuando falta poco para la primera vuelta
titulo.en: Lula and Bolsonaro in dead heat as Brazil goes to polls

sintesis.es: En Brasil, las encuestas apuntan a un empate entre el líder de la izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva y el candidato de la extrema derecha, Flávio Bolsonaro, de darse la segunda vuelta. La primera vuelta de las elecciones presidenciales tendrá lugar este domingo 4 de octubre.
sintesis.en: Brazilian presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro on Thursday bowed out of the final debate ahead of elections pitting him against leader Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, who also declined to attend. Lula, on the cusp of 81, will face off against the son of ex-leader Jair Bolsonaro in a first-round vote on Sunday, with polls giving him a slight advantage. The pair are neck-and-neck in projections for a potential runoff on October 25, however.

titulo.en: New method generates nearly indistinguishable photons for quantum communication

sintesis.es: Las nuevas directrices llegan mientras el Gobierno de Trump afronta críticas por las muertes provocadas a manos de los agentes migratorios. La agencia minimiza las medidas y sostiene que solo recuerdan normas ya vigentes.
sintesis.en: Working in close collaboration, researchers from Paderborn University, the University of Basel and Ruhr University Bochum have made a breakthrough in quantum communication. In their recently published paper in the journal Physical Review Letters, they demonstrate how special semiconductor nanostructures can be used to generate individual photons and pairs of photons that are almost perfectly identical. These "indistinguishable" particles form the basis for quantum entanglement and quantum interference.

titulo.es: France closes 400 high schools as teens protests escalate
titulo.en: France closes 400 high schools as teens protests escalate

sintesis.es: Almost 400 high schools were closed across France on Friday over a week-long protest movement by pupils over inadequate conditions at schools including overheated classrooms and a lack of teachers. The protests have seen students clash with police with some 2,000 people arrested, with pupils also blocking access to schools. France 24’s Olivia Bizot reports from outside a high school near Paris where she says many protesters are also decrying what they says is the use of police violence.

sintesis.en: The Riyadh International Humanitarian Forum 2025 was a significant event that underscored the continued partnership between WHO and KSrelief, as well as with other international partners to address critical humanitarian health crises. The agreements made during the forum are pivotal in combating diseases like malaria, cholera, and polio, and ensuring better healthcare for displaced populations. The forum also highlighted Saudi Arabia’s ongoing commitment to global humanitarian efforts, reaffirming its leadership role in tackling some of the world’s pressing health crises.

titulo.es: Un año después del alto el fuego, Gaza enfrenta crisis humanitaria con aumento de violencia sexual y matrimonios forzados
titulo.en: One year after ceasefire, Gaza faces humanitarian crisis with rising sexual violence and forced marriages

sintesis.es: Organismos de la ONU reportan que la guerra en Gaza ha provocado un aumento de casos de violencia sexual y matrimonios forzados de niñas y mujeres, con familias que ofrecen a sus hijas a cambio de alimentos. Un año después del alto el fuego, la población gazatí sigue sin acceso suficiente a agua potable y materiales de reconstrucción, mientras programas de empleo temporal de la ONU buscan paliar la falta de ingresos.
sintesis.en: UN agencies report that the war in Gaza has led to an increase in sexual violence and forced marriages of girls and women, with some families offering daughters in exchange for food. A year after the ceasefire, Gaza's population still lacks sufficient access to clean water and reconstruction materials, while UN cash-for-work programs aim to address the lack of income.

sintesis.es: The World Health Organization (WHO) has certified Timor-Leste as malaria-free, a remarkable achievement for a country that prioritized the disease and embarked on a concerted, nation-wide response shortly after gaining independence in 2002. “WHO congratulates the people and government of Timor-Leste on this significant milestone,” said Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, WHO Director-General. “Timor-Leste’s success proves that malaria can be stopped in its tracks when strong political will, smart interventions, sustained domestic and external investment and dedicated health workers unite.” With today’s announcement, a total of 47 countries and 1 territory have been certified as malaria-free by WHO.
